N, M = map(int, input().split())
S = [list(input()) for _ in range(N)]

ans = N + 1

for bit in range(1 << N):  # Iterate over all possible combinations of stalls

    store = []
    for i in range(N):  # Check each stall
        if bit >> i & 1:  # If the i-th bit is set
            store.append(i)  # Add the stall index to store
    
    data = [0] * M
    for s_i in store:  # For each selected stall index
        for j, s_j in enumerate(S[s_i]):
            if s_j == 'o':  # If the j-th popcorn type is present
                data[j] += 1  # Increment the count for that popcorn type
    
    if all(x >= 1 for x in data):  # Check if all popcorn types are covered
        ans = min(ans, len(store))  # Update the minimum number of stalls

print(ans)
